items.title: Observing the Summer Midday Ban
items.text: From June 15 to September 15, all work under direct sun exposure is banned daily between 12:00 and 15:00 (حظر العمل تحت أشعة الشمس) — violations are reported via hotline 19911.

items.title: Enforcing Split Shifts During the Ban Window
items.text: The schedule must mandatorily provide for split assignments during this window — tedious to coordinate by hand across many sites and teams.

items.title: Nitaqat Minimum Wage Tracked
items.text: A Saudi employee counts as a full unit (1.0) toward the Saudization quota only if the GOSI-insured salary is at least SAR 4,000 per month — critical for facility management firms.
